questions.question: What refrain opens Ecclesiastes?
options: Blessed is the man who walks not in wicked counsel
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good
Vanity of vanities! All is vanity
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom
questions.answer: Vanity of vanities! All is vanity

questions.question: What does the Preacher say about new things under the sun?
options: Each generation invents what those before it never knew
Whatever is new soon grows old and is forgotten
There is nothing new under the sun
Only the wise can bring forth something truly new
questions.answer: There is nothing new under the sun

questions.question: The Preacher (Qoheleth) identifies himself as a son of David, king in Jerusalem.
Futility of futilities, says the Teacher; everything is _____.
What has been is what will be, and there is nothing new under the _____.
